reuseRule: One screened member only; candidate method/bundle, JAR, case inputs, options and rubric remain byte-identical. Reuse all three registered screening runs in DEVELOPMENT; no rerun or claim of independent replication.
fullDevelopmentGate: All ten candidate cases must be executed and source-reviewable; preserve own-group analysis correction, do not regress previously passing analysis/final answers, introduce no new material numeric/factual errors, and do not reduce final-answer pass count. Otherwise do not consume transfer.
